refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: io.systemd.Resolve is a Varlink interface implemented by systemd1-related components. It can be introspected and called with varlinkctl1.

refsect1.title: Interface Definition
refsect1.para: The following interface definition is exposed:
refsect1.programlisting:
interface io.systemd.Resolve
# The type of protocol. type DNSProtocol( # DNS dns, # Multicast DNS mdns, # LLMNR llmnr )
# The mode of DNSOverTLS. type DNSOverTLSMode( # DNSOverTLS is disabled. no, # DNSOverTLS is enabled. yes, # Try to use DNSOverTLS, but disabled when the server does not support it. opportunistic )
# Whether the protocol is enabled. type ResolveSupport( # The protocol is disabled. no, # The protocol is enabled. yes, # The protocol is used only for resolving. resolve )
# The management mode of /etc/resolve.conf file. type ResolvConfMode( # /etc/resolv.conf is a symbolic link to /run/systemd/resolve/resolv.conf. uplink, # /etc/resolv.conf is a symbolic link to /run/systemd/resolve/stub-resolv.conf. stub, # /etc/resolv.conf is a symbolic link to /usr/lib/systemd/resolv.conf. static, # /etc/resolv.conf does not exist. missing, # /etc/resolv.conf is not managed by systemd-resolved. foreign )
# Describes the update flag for browsing services, indicating whether a service was added or removed during browsing. type BrowseServiceUpdateFlag( # Indicates that the service was added. added, # Indicates that the service was removed. removed )
# Encapsulates a resolved address. type ResolvedAddress( ifindex: ?int, family: int, address: []int )
# Encapsulates a resolved host name. type ResolvedName( ifindex: ?int, name: string )
# Encapsulates resolved service information. type ResolvedService( priority: int, weight: int, port: int, hostname: string, canonicalName: ?string, addresses: ?[]ResolvedAddress )
# Encapsulates the canonical name, type and domain of a DNS-SD or simple SRV service. Note that due to CNAME redirections and similar, a named DNS-SD service might resolve to a canonical service that is an unnamed simple SRV service. Or in other words: resolving a named service might return an unnamed canonical service. type ResolvedCanonical( # The DNS-SD name of the service. For simple SRV services this field is absent or null. name: ?string, type: string, domain: string )
# The 'key' part of a DNS resource record. type ResourceKey( # The RR class, almost always IN, i.e 0x01. If unspecified defaults to IN. class: ?int, # The RR types, one of A, AAAA, PTR, … type: int, # The domain name. name: string )
# A full DNS resource record.. type ResourceRecord( key: ResourceKey, priority: ?int, weight: ?int, port: ?int, name: ?string, cpu: ?string, os: ?string, items: ?[]string, address: ?[]int, mname: ?string, rname: ?string, serial: ?int, refresh: ?int, retry: ?int, expire: ?int, minimum: ?int, exchange: ?string, version: ?int, size: ?int, horiz_pre: ?int, vert_pre: ?int, latitude: ?int, longitude: ?int, altitude: ?int, keyTag: ?int, algorithm: ?int, digestType: ?int, digest: ?string, fptype: ?int, fingerprint: ?string, flags: ?int, protocol: ?int, dnskey: ?string, signer: ?string, typeCovered: ?int, labels: ?int, originalTtl: ?int, expiration: ?int, inception: ?int, signature: ?string, nextDomain: ?string, types: ?[]int, iterations: ?int, salt: ?string, hash: ?string, certUsage: ?int, selector: ?int, matchingType: ?int, data: ?string, tag: ?string, value: ?string, target: ?string, svcparams: ?object, order: ?int, preference: ?int, naptrFlags: ?string, services: ?string, regexp: ?string, replacement: ?string )
# Encapsulates information about a resolved DNS resource record type ResolvedRecord( ifindex: ?int, rr: ?ResourceRecord, raw: string )
# Encapsulates the service data obtained from browsing. type ServiceData( updateFlag: BrowseServiceUpdateFlag, # The address family of the service, one of AF_INET or AF_INET6. family: int, # The name of the service, e.g., 'My Service'. May be null if not specified. name: ?string, # The type of service, e.g., '_http._tcp'. type: string, # The domain in which the service resides, e.g., 'local'. domain: string, # The Linux interface index for the network interface associated with this service. ifindex: int )
# Encapsulates a DNS server address specification. type DNSServer( # IPv4 or IPv6 address of the server. address: []int, # IPv4 or IPv6 address of the server, formatted as a human-readable string. addressString: ?string, # Address family of the server, one of AF_INET or AF_INET6. family: int, # Port number of the server. port: int, # Interface index for which this server is configured. ifindex: ?int, # Server Name Indication (SNI) of the server. name: ?string, # Indicates if the DNS server is accessible or not. accessible: bool )
# Encapsulates a search domain specification. type SearchDomain( # Domain name. name: string, # Indicates whether or not this is a routing-only domain. routeOnly: bool, # Interface index for which this search domain is configured. ifindex: ?int )
# Encapsulates a global or per-link DNS configuration, including configured DNS servers, search domains, and more. type DNSConfiguration( # Interface name, if any, associated with this configuration. Empty for global configuration. ifname: ?string, # Interface index, if any, associated with this configuration. Empty for global configuration. ifindex: ?int, # Delegate name, if any, associated with this configuration. Empty for global or link configurations. delegate: ?string, # Indicates whether or not this link's DNS servers will be used for resolving domain names that do not match any link's configured domains. defaultRoute: ?bool, # DNS server currently selected to use for lookups. currentServer: ?DNSServer, # Array of configured DNS servers. servers: ?[]DNSServer, # Array of configured fallback DNS servers, set for global configuration only. fallbackServers: ?[]DNSServer, # Array of configured search domains. searchDomains: ?[]SearchDomain, # Array of configured DNSSEC negative trust anchors. negativeTrustAnchors: ?[]string, # DNSSEC mode. dnssec: ?string, # Indicates if the current DNS server supports DNSSEC. Always false if DNSSEC mode is "no". dnssecSupported: ?bool, # DNSOverTLS mode. dnsOverTLS: ?DNSOverTLSMode, # LLMNR support. llmnr: ?string, # mDNS support. mDNS: ?ResolveSupport, # resolv.conf mode, set for global configuration only. resolvConfMode: ?ResolvConfMode, # Array of current DNS scopes. scopes: ?[]DNSScope )
# Encapsulates a DNS scope specification. type DNSScope( # Protocol associated with this scope. protocol: DNSProtocol, # Address family associated with this scope. family: ?int, # Interface index associated with this scope. ifindex: ?int, # Interface name associated with this scope. ifname: ?string, # DNSSEC mode associated with this scope. dnssec: ?string, # DNSOverTLS mode associated with this scope. dnsOverTLS: ?DNSOverTLSMode )
# Resolves a hostname to one or more IP addresses. method ResolveHostname( # The Linux interface index for the network interface to search on. Typically left unspecified, in order to search on all interfaces. ifindex: ?int, # The host name to resolve. name: string, # The address family to search for, one of AF_INET or AF_INET6. family: ?int, # Various search flags. flags: ?int ) -> ( # Array of resolved IP addresses addresses: []ResolvedAddress, # Canonical name of the host. name: string, # Various flags indicating details on discovered data. flags: int )
# Resolves an IP address to a hostname. method ResolveAddress( # The Linux interface index for the network interface to search on. Typically left unspecified, in order to search on all interfaces. ifindex: ?int, # The address family of the specified address, one of AF_INET or AF_INET6. family: int, # The IP address to look up, either 4 or 16 integers (depending if an AF_INET or AF_INET6 address shall be resolved). address: []int, flags: ?int ) -> ( names: []ResolvedName, flags: int )
# Resolves a named DNS-SD or unnamed simple SRV service. method ResolveService( name: ?string, type: ?string, domain: string, ifindex: ?int, family: ?int, flags: ?int ) -> ( services: []ResolvedService, txt: ?[]string, canonical: ResolvedCanonical, flags: int )
# Resolves a domain name to one or more DNS resource records. method ResolveRecord( ifindex: ?int, name: string, class: ?int, type: int, flags: ?int ) -> ( rrs: []ResolvedRecord, flags: int )
# Starts browsing for DNS-SD services of specified type. # [Requires 'more' flag] method BrowseServices( # The domain to browse for services. If null, the default browsing domain local is used. domain: ?string, # The service type to browse for (e.g., '_http._tcp'). type: ?string, # The Linux interface index for the network interface to search on. ifindex: ?int, # Various browsing flags to modify the operation. flags: ?int ) -> ( # An array of service data containing information about discovered services. browserServiceData: []ServiceData )
# Current global and per-link DNS configurations. method DumpDNSConfiguration() -> ( # The current global and per-interface DNS configurations configuration: []DNSConfiguration )
error NoNameServers()
error NoSuchResourceRecord()
error QueryTimedOut()
error MaxAttemptsReached()
error InvalidReply()
error QueryAborted()
error QueryRefused()
error DNSSECValidationFailed( result: string, extendedDNSErrorCode: ?int, extendedDNSErrorMessage: ?string )
error NoTrustAnchor()
error ResourceRecordTypeUnsupported()
error NetworkDown()
error NoSource()
error StubLoop()
error DNSError( rcode: int, queryString: string, extendedDNSErrorCode: ?int, extendedDNSErrorMessage: ?string )
error CNAMELoop()
error BadAddressSize()
error ResourceRecordTypeInvalidForQuery()
error ZoneTransfersNotPermitted()
error ResourceRecordTypeObsolete()
# The DNS resource records of the specified service are not consistent (e.g. lacks a DNS-SD service type when resolved). error InconsistentServiceRecords()
# The service is explicitly not provided on the queried domain (RFC 2782 root domain SRV record). error ServiceNotProvided()

refsect1.title: Examples
refsect1.para: varlinkctl introspect SERVICE io.systemd.Resolve shows the interface definition as served by SERVICE, and varlinkctl call SERVICE io.systemd.Resolve.ResolveHostname '{}' invokes its ResolveHostname method.
